# Path-traced film from code: a short where the agent writes the renderer too

**A story becomes a short film from a path tracer the agent writes itself: SDF characters, analytic grass, a numpy score, no assets.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_39d3436e5fa9.webp" alt="A clay mouse in a red scarf looks up at a glowing firefly in tall night grass, path traced by a renderer written in code." width="480"></p>

Make a short animated film in which everything is code the agent writes, including the renderer: a path tracer in one WebGL2 shader (no Blender, no three.js, no meshes, no textures), characters and props as signed distance fields, a meadow of analytic curved grass blades, moon, firefly and window lights with soft shadows, depth of field and motion blur, a variance-guided denoiser, a score synthesized in numpy from the same timeline, captions and an encode. Includes the complete tested film "The Smallest Star" (70 s, 11 shots, two characters) as a starter, a live page that runs the same renderer in the browser, and the speed-ups and traps found while making it. Use when someone asks for a film, short or music piece "made entirely in code", "write your own renderer / ray tracer / path tracer and make a film with it", a storybook or clay-diorama 3D short without Blender, a "no assets, no video model" showcase of what a coding model can do, or a remake of The Smallest Star with another story. Not for a Blender film (blender-code-film), a three.js explainer (code-3d-explainer), recording a browser game (code-game-trailer), 2D motion graphics (kinetic-type-art, hyperframes) or AI-generated footage (varg-ai).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill code-path-traced-film                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills code-path-traced-film --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| Typical cost | free locally: 70 s at 1280x720 (1,560 frames) in 1 h 46 min on a MacBook Pro M4 Pro (measured) |

## Ask your agent

- "Write a 30-second fable about a snail and a lighthouse and film it with a path tracer you write yourself: no Blender, no assets"
- "Remake The Smallest Star with my story, a paper boat that wants to reach the sea. Keep the night look, 6 shots"
- "Make a 20-second clay-diorama short entirely in code with its own renderer and a synthesized score, plus a live page where I can drag the camera"
